NOTE (not a bug): Web splash never plays the video (component returns black view when Platform.OS === 'web'), so the audio-fade behavior on web is essentially a no-op. This is by design in SplashVideo.tsx:144-151. The volume-fade code paths for native builds look correct and defensive (try/catch around every volume mutation).
critical_code_review_comments: SplashVideo.tsx dismiss(): the 12-step setTimeout audio fade fires asynchronously and is not cleared if the component unmounts mid-fade — the setTimeouts will still run and touch a possibly-freed player. Low risk (each step is wrapped in try/catch), but worth tracking the timers in a ref and clearing on unmount.
Both login.tsx and signup.tsx still ship large blocks of unused styles from the removed captcha/Google features — harmless but adds ~135 lines of dead code across the two files.
